Name: Chocobo Valley Remixed (Unofficial)
Author: Ex0dus
Description:
[center][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49743/49743-1792116847-1654617959.png[/img][/font][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Chocobo Valley Remixed is a reworking of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url] mod by Kitsutsune. It adds multiple uses for all of the items in that mod as well as adding lots of additional content to go with it! Chocobos now also have a progression between species with higher tiers of Chocobos providing higher value items.[/font][/size][/color]


[center][size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49743/49743-1792116852-873416858.png[/img][/font][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Chocobo Progression with configurable difficulty: Instead of being able to get any large breed of Chocobo once you have an Ostrich Incubator, you must now pay Buckwheat an item from a lower tier Chocobo to get a common egg of a higher tier Chocobo. In the default difficulty, the required item is a rare egg. In the easier difficulty, it is an uncommon item. The easier setting increases progression speed by about 40%.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]At the beginning you will only have access to the Ferngill Mini and Jylland Dwarf Chocobos. Each has its own progression path to follow with different breeds. To see the progression paths, click on the spoiler below:[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][spoiler][size=3][font=Arial]Path 1: Ferngill Mini -->  Lucian Palfrey --> Vana'delian Courser --> Ivalician Draft

Path 2: Jylland Dwarf --> Eorzean Destrier --> Pulsian Steppe -->  Ivalician Draft[/font][/size][/spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Special orders that have effects on the game: Care has been taken to make special orders that give rewards beyond just money or another item (though those are included too). Some special orders increase your efficiency with furnaces, others give new uses to outdated resources and yet others affect shops. Chocobo Valley Remixed should feel like it is part of the game world.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Every Chocobo Valley item has been given multiple uses. Some items are used in newly added recipes, others in one of two new buildable merchant shops, others have been integrated with other mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46186]Appleseed's Lathe[/url] and HarrisonGrey's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43265]Cheesemaker's Guild[/url]. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Eorzean and Pulsian Chocobos have been reworked. Eorzean Chocobos now drop dolls which can be placed like furniture but also sold like items. Pulsian Chocobos now dig up special geodes with great rewards, new powerful flower seeds and valuable bones (which go great with the Lathe mod)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Chocobo Egg and Mayo Rework: Later tier Chocobo eggs are more valuable and Chocobo Mayo retains the quality of the egg used to make it, making Chocobo mayo unique and useful.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Bugfixes*: Several minor bugs from Chocobo Valley have been fixed, mostly relating to Perfection.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Gift Tastes: Gift tastes have been added for Chocobo Valley* and Chocobo Valley Remixed items. For a list of mods, click [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4517]here[/url][/font][/size]
  [/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Arial]*Bugfixes and Gift Tastes for original Chocobo Valley items will be removed from this mod once Kitsutsune adds them to Chocobo Valley. [/font][/size]
